## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and commits are small and focused (one logical change each)
- [ ] Rule, parser or autofix changes have positive and negative tests
- [ ] README and `--help` updated for user-visible changes, and a line added under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
